name: The Links Winter Floating League - Session I
oneLiner: A two-person scramble that plays across both locations: your team plays against the field from The Links of Lakeville and The Links of Stillwater together.
beginnerNote: A scramble is the friendliest format there is: you both hit, you take the better ball and go again from there. Handicaps level the field, so nobody has to card a bad hole on their own.
format: Scramble league. 2 players per team. 18 holes on the simulator. Handicapped at 80%. Teams play against the field from both Lakeville and Stillwater. The team's handicap updates after each league week, from the team's own scores.
